home.whyUsIntro: The educational programs of {{name}} are implemented within the framework of the Bologna Process parameters, meet modern requirements, are based on the educational systems of leading universities worldwide, and correspond to labor market demands.
home.aboutText: Training of specialists who are competitive in the modern labor market, distinguished by their intelligence, high culture and tolerance.

about.historyText: {{name}} is a fictional university template created to demonstrate the structure of a modern university website. Over {{years}} years of notional history, the university has grown to {{students}} students and {{bachelor}} bachelor's programs.
about.missionText: Training specialists who are competitive in today's labor market and distinguished by intellect, high culture, and tolerance.
visionText: {{name}} is a higher education institution that effectively carries out educational, research, and character-building activity on the principles of openness and academic integrity. The university sees itself as an innovation hub for educational and research services, aimed at transferring knowledge and technology, supporting student initiatives, and commercializing research results.
The university's educational activity is aimed at creating, accumulating, and disseminating modern knowledge, drawing on the potential of its research laboratories and teaching-and-research centers.

{{name}} strives for a leading position in training specialists for various sectors of the economy, combining the quality of education with the introduction of innovative technologies and support for the cultural and moral values of society.
about.dormText: {{name}} students have access to a student residence with 180 beds. The residence offers comfortable conditions: a dining hall, shower rooms, a laundry, a study area, and free Wi-Fi. Places are allocated on a contractual basis at the start of the academic year — the university's student affairs office handles move-in matters.
about.inclusiveText: {{name}} creates a comfortable, barrier-free environment for students with special educational needs. Our goal is to help every student realize their potential and succeed in their studies.
inclusiveItems: A barrier-free environment: ramps, accessible entrances, tactile guides
An accessible site version for the visually impaired and sign-language interpretation
